goals.title: Build SEIS Command Center as the central operating interface
goals.description: Create the core operating interface for repository status, docs, roadmap, security, approvals, evidence, and readiness.
blockers: Complete app shell is not proven
risks: UI could overstate implementation status if evidence states are not enforced
goals.validation_method: Static/manual Command Center views render evidence-backed states without LLM or live integrations.
goals.next_action: Build static/manual Command Center views from docs and fixture data.

goals.title: Establish SEIS Goal Tracking OS
goals.description: Create the long-term goal, milestone, blocker, evidence, validation, and next-action system.
blockers: Command Center UI implementation is not built yet
risks: Goal records can drift unless validated against evidence links
goals.validation_method: Goal docs exist, structured goal records validate, and local checks record known blockers.
goals.next_action: Keep structured goal data, planning horizons, progress ledger, generated view model, and static Command Center page in sync.
goals.notes: Documentation and data foundation active; daily and weekly review logs exist; application module remains planned.

goals.title: Build deterministic Repository Intelligence
goals.description: Create local read-only scanners for missing docs, risky files, stale records, validation gaps, and readiness blockers.
blockers: Missing validation scripts remain unresolved
risks: Scanner output could become noisy if it is not bounded
goals.validation_method: Read-only scanner emits stable findings and does not perform destructive cleanup.
goals.next_action: Implement read-only scanner outputs after current repo hygiene blockers are resolved.
goals.notes: Planned; goal validator is a first narrow scanner.

goals.title: Maintain official documentation and source-of-truth navigation
goals.description: Keep official documentation, roadmap, status, and review records navigable and distinct from archives.
blockers: Root architecture, roadmap, and changelog docs are still missing
risks: Historical docs can conflict with active status
goals.validation_method: Docs index links current source-of-truth docs and known blockers are visible.
goals.next_action: Keep docs index, status, backlog, and PR queue current.

goals.title: Enforce security and governance through platform rules
goals.description: Track secret handling, approval gates, action risk, security findings, and public exposure blockers.
blockers: Live GitHub security status is unknown
risks: Security readiness could be overstated without scans
goals.validation_method: Security and approval docs exist; scans record exact commands and missing checks.
goals.next_action: Add deeper local-only security checks and approval ledger.
goals.notes: Active governance foundation; not a full security audit.

goals.title: Stabilize GitHub workflow and PR rescue
goals.description: Recover and classify open/closed PR work safely without pushing, merging, or deleting without approval.
dependencies: Human approval for live GitHub inspection
blockers: External GitHub PR state was not queried
Dirty worktree contains pre-existing deletions
risks: Recovering PRs without classification could revive unsafe work
goals.validation_method: GitHub CLI/API evidence is captured after approval and each PR is classified.
goals.next_action: Resolve local deletion set, then inspect GitHub PRs after approval.
goals.notes: Blocked by approval and local hygiene.

goals.title: Prepare public repository readiness
goals.description: Establish public-readiness checks for docs, security, provenance, templates, validation, and blockers.
blockers: Foundation check fails
Source-of-truth docs are missing
risks: Public readiness claim would be misleading before blockers are resolved
goals.validation_method: Public readiness dry-run records exact checks and blockers.
goals.next_action: Complete repo hygiene and validation recovery first.

goals.title: Prepare release readiness without unsafe deployment
goals.description: Define release dry-runs, changelog policy, artifact state, rollback, and post-release follow-up.
blockers: Release artifacts exist but release sync was not validated
Deployment is approval-gated
risks: Release claim without validation could expose broken artifacts
goals.validation_method: Release dry-run records artifact inventory, validation, rollback, and blocked deployment actions.
goals.next_action: Define changelog/artifact policy and run dry-runs after validation recovery.

goals.title: Build SEIS design system foundation
goals.description: Create calm, premium, accessible tokens, components, status states, and UI patterns for Command Center.
blockers: No component demo yet
risks: UI may become decorative unless evidence states are enforced
goals.validation_method: Fixture-driven component demo renders required states accessibly.
goals.next_action: Create fixture-driven component/state demo.

goals.title: Define agent runtime permission model
goals.description: Define human-supervised agent roles, allowed actions, forbidden actions, validation, and approvals.
blockers: Agent runtime spec is not written yet
risks: Agents could be over-permissioned without explicit boundaries
goals.validation_method: Agent runtime spec defines permissions and approval boundaries before privileged actions exist.
goals.next_action: Add agent runtime specification before privileged actions.

goals.title: Create safe automation queues and approval workflows
goals.description: Track task, review, approval, validation, evidence, and release queues with safe defaults.
blockers: No approval ledger implementation yet
risks: Automation could run actions before approval gates are enforced
goals.validation_method: Static approval ledger and queue schema exist before live automations.
goals.next_action: Add static approval ledger and queue schema.

goals.title: Define provider-neutral model router
goals.description: Define replaceable provider interfaces, routing policies, model profiles, and privacy-aware logging.
blockers: No model-router contract docs yet
risks: Provider routing could leak secrets if browser/server boundaries are unclear
goals.validation_method: Provider interface docs exist and no provider keys are exposed.
goals.next_action: Add model-router provider interface and routing policy docs.

goals.title: Define prompt engine and versioning
goals.description: Define prompt format, versioning, templates, provenance, safety, and clean-room restrictions.
blockers: No prompt-engine docs yet
risks: Prompts could become unreviewable without versioning
goals.validation_method: Prompt format/versioning docs exist and contain no secrets or proprietary prompts.
goals.next_action: Add prompt format/versioning and template rules.

goals.title: Define evaluation lab for prompts, routing, agents, and model claims
goals.description: Create evaluation smoke gates and regression checks that prevent unsupported AI capability claims.
blockers: Foundation validation blockers remain
risks: Evaluation claims could be overstated without measured runs
goals.validation_method: Evaluation smoke plan and measured outputs exist before capability claims.
goals.next_action: Add evaluation smoke plan after validation scripts are recovered.

goals.title: Build provenance-aware knowledge system
goals.description: Create knowledge records that distinguish official docs, generated reports, archives, and evidence.
blockers: Knowledge record model is not designed yet
risks: Archives could be mistaken for official direction
goals.validation_method: Knowledge records classify source, status, provenance, and archive boundaries.
goals.next_action: Define knowledge records and archive separation rules.

goals.title: Define SSH/cloud workspace policy
goals.description: Document local, GitHub, Codespaces, SSH/cloud, backup, sync, key boundaries, and approval-gated remote operations.
dependencies: Human approval for live SSH operations
blockers: SSH operations require explicit approval
risks: Private keys or host details could be exposed if boundaries are weak
goals.validation_method: Workspace policy exists; no SSH command is run without approval.
goals.next_action: Add workspace policy doc; do not run SSH.

goals.title: Establish SEIS Universe research direction without overclaiming
goals.description: Document model research direction while distinguishing provider models, prompts, routing, memory, and future SEIS-owned weights.
blockers: No training, checkpoint, tokenizer, dataset, or evaluation evidence was reviewed
risks: Model capability or ownership could be overclaimed
goals.validation_method: Research docs separate future model work from provider routing and measured evidence.
goals.next_action: Add model baseline and research roadmap docs later.

goals.title: Keep portfolio and creative systems aligned with SEIS product direction
goals.description: Classify creative and portfolio surfaces so they support the SEIS ecosystem without becoming unrelated clutter.
blockers: Creative/portfolio surfaces are not classified yet
risks: Creative assets could drift away from platform goals
goals.validation_method: Creative surfaces are classified and linked to product goals.
goals.next_action: Classify creative and portfolio surfaces after repo hygiene recovery.

goals.title: Maintain long-term product vision and review cadence
goals.description: Keep SEIS direction, review cadence, and next priorities visible without creating fake reviews.
blockers: Monthly review must be performed before cadence can be marked complete
risks: Review templates could be mistaken for completed reviews
goals.validation_method: Review records contain date, scope, evidence, blockers, and validation output.
goals.next_action: Keep cadence, planning horizon, and progress ledger records visible; perform monthly review only when current-period evidence exists.

goals.title: Define SEIS AI Core as an application layer without overclaiming model ownership
goals.description: Define AI Core as provider-neutral routing, prompts, agent runtime, memory, evaluation, and audit infrastructure without claiming frontier model ownership.
blockers: Deleted package and validation files block implementation readiness claims
risks: SEIS AI Core could be mistaken for a trained foundation model without clear boundaries
goals.validation_method: AI Core contracts define provider, prompt, runtime, memory, evaluation, and audit boundaries without secrets or model ownership claims.
goals.next_action: Add AI Core contracts for router, prompt engine, runtime, memory, evals, and audit.
goals.notes: Planned; no provider call or model training performed.
